scope: Static source/config/test review plus project tests; no external penetration testing, training, CUDA, or download.

secret_scan.limits: Pattern scan; raw corpus, binary files and .venv excluded.

controls: Archive absolute and parent traversal rejected; archives stream without extraction.
Input line, JSON, archive member and expanded size limits present.
StorageManager and CorpusMetadataStore confine resolved paths.
Invalid JSON/UTF-8/corrupt archive cases covered in tests.
Original SQLite opened via mode=ro; no write/checkpoint/migration.
Approved-source gate, explicit DownloadManager request, byte cap and provenance checksum present; no network download made.
Current PyTorch checkpoint load uses weights_only=True.

findings.description: RegistrySync previously accepted external DB/registry paths.
findings.fix: Reject resolved paths outside project root.

findings.description: DownloadManager custom config could direct DB/raw output outside root.
findings.fix: Resolve and confine both paths to root.
findings.verification: Parent traversal and absolute external path regressions pass.

findings.description: Missing source_record_id was replaced by import/split line labels.
findings.fix: Missing ID remains NULL; line number stays metadata.
findings.verification: Regression/full suite pass; 55,716 old split fallback values remain unmigrated.

findings.description: Transformer checkpoint reader falls back to unrestricted torch.load only if PyTorch lacks weights_only.
findings.runtime: Current PyTorch 2.15.0+cpu takes safe weights_only path.
findings.recommendation: Load trusted checkpoints only; consider removing old-version fallback when compatible.

findings.description: Low-level download_resumable accepts caller-selected destination; high-level DownloadManager is root-confined.
TokenSequenceDataset uses OS TemporaryDirectory for token cache.
findings.evidence: Six pre-existing nourai-token-cache directories dated Nov 10/12; none created or modified Nov 13.
findings.recommendation: Add scratch-root configuration if policy requires all temporary files inside project.
